news.headline: Putin hosts Trump envoy; Russia frees US detainee
news.body: Russian President Vladimir Putin met US special envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg on Oct 21 to discuss new proposals for ending the war in Ukraine. Russia announced the release of American detainee Stephen Hubbard as a goodwill gesture, while Western officials urged caution about the talks' prospects.
